Interium is an AI interior design app that helps you reimagine your home decor and room interiors. Transform any space—your living room, bedroom, bathroom, or kitchen—into a stylish room with new furniture, wall colors, and flooring. Explore creative home design ideas, discover fresh decor inspiration, and visualize every detail before making a single change.

Planning a home makeover, refreshing your living room decor, or exploring new interior decorating trends? Snap a photo, choose a style, and watch your space transform—no designer needed.

【 WHAT YOU CAN DO 】

▶Interior Design
Wondering how your room would look in a different style? Upload a photo, choose from 15+ curated AI interior design styles—Modern, Japandi, Mid-Century, Scandinavian, Minimalist, and more—and get a photorealistic redesign in seconds. Want a specific look? Pick a color palette to match your taste. Want to start fresh? Enable Remove Current Furniture to clear the room first.

▶Rearrange Furniture
What if that sofa looked better by the window? Rearrange, swap, and try different furniture layouts instantly—without moving a thing.

▶Virtual Staging
Need to stage an empty property without the cost? Fill any room with curated home decor and furniture choices to help buyers see its potential—perfect for listings on Zillow, Redfin, or Realtor.com.

▶Design from Reference
Spotted a living room on Pinterest or Instagram you love? Upload any inspiration image and Interium will recreate that aesthetic in your own space.

▶Furniture Finder
Love a piece of furniture but have no idea where to buy it? Add an image or snap a photo and Interium will identify it instantly. Browse visually similar furniture from online furniture stores, compare prices across matching products, and purchase favorites.

▶Change Flooring & Paint Walls
Not sure about that paint color or new flooring? Test any wall color or wall paint on your actual room—no guessing, no regret.

▶Object Replace
Want to see how new furniture or decor would look before you buy? Make targeted changes with simple prompts—swap furniture, restyle cabinets, or try different decor accents.

▶Garden Design
Curious what your backyard or patio could become? Explore outdoor garden and landscape design templates—Mediterranean, Japanese Zen, Xeriscaping, and more.

▶Interior & Outdoor Decor
Want to deck out your home, inside and out, for the holidays? Add garlands, lights, and seasonal accents for Christmas, Halloween, and beyond—no decorator required.

【 WHO IT’S FOR 】

- Homeowners & renters who want to visualize a new look before spending a dollar
- Real estate agents who need fast, professional virtual staging for listings
- Interior designers looking for quick AI interior design concepts to present to clients
- DIY decorators & design inspiration hunters who want to recreate styles they discover online

【 FAQ 】

Q: How can I redesign my room with AI?
A: Take a photo, choose a style, and tap Generate. Interium creates a photorealistic redesign in seconds.

Q: How can I virtually stage a home for sale?
A: Upload a photo of an empty room, pick a style, and Interium fills it with furniture and decor instantly.

Q: Can I make small changes without redesigning the whole room?
A: Yes. Change wall colors, update flooring, rearrange furniture, or swap decor—without touching the rest of your room.

Q: Can I recreate a design style I saw online?
A: Upload any inspiration image and Interium will recreate that look in your own space.

Join over 10M+ rooms already transformed with AI home design. See what your home could become—and make it a space you’re proud to show off.

The app requires iOS 17.0 or later.

- You can subscribe to everything the app has to offer.
- Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the selected subscription plan.

By using the app, you agree to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

Decory – Your Room, Reimagined by AI

Your room could look completely different. Decory is the AI interior design app and room decorator that lets you visualize room transformations and see photo-realistic redesigns—before you move a single piece of furniture.

Most people spend hours—sometimes thousands—making design decisions they can't visualise first. Wrong furniture. Wrong colours. A room that never quite feels right. Decory changes that. Upload a photo, sketch a layout, or describe your space—and get affordable interior design in seconds. No design skills needed. No consultation fees.
Made for moments like these

Moving into a new place and want to see it styled before buying a single thing. Renting and looking for decor ideas without committing to changes. Planning a renovation and need to see the outcome before spending anything. Refreshing a bedroom, living room, dining room, bathroom, kitchen, home office, or small apartment—or exploring diy interior design for a small room—whatever your space, Decory makes the decision easier.

Find a Style That Feels Like You

• Take the Taste Quiz Swipe through 10+ design cards and Decory learns what you love. Your taste profile is saved in My Styles and applied to every room you design.
• Browse 20 Curated Styles Minimalist Interior, Scandinavian Interior, Boho Interior Design, Industrial Interior, Zen Room Design, Biophilic Design, Victorian Interior, Luxury Interior Design, Farmhouse, Contemporary, Maximalist Interior, and more. Each one hand-picked—tap to make it yours.
• Use a Saved Style Return to a style you love and apply it to a new room. Your design identity, always ready.
Start Any Way You Want
• Template Choose from 94 curated room layouts across living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, and office. The room shape is already right—just add your style.
• AI Architect Describe your room in plain language and Decory builds the floor plan. Or draw it yourself in Draw mode with real measurements. No photos needed.
• Photo Scan The most accurate start: capture four corners of your room and Decory rebuilds the space before redesigning it.
• Sketch Draw a rough outline—wonky lines welcome. Each stroke becomes a wall, aand Decory turns it into a stylish room design.

The AI Does the Heavy Lifting

Decory analyzes, styles, furnishes, and renders your room. Then you swipe through the results and pick your five favorites—and Decory combines them into one refined design, tuning the lighting, adding details, and applying a final polish. You get notified the moment it is ready. Generate as many variations as you want—no limits.
Walk Away With a Complete Execution Plan

Your finished design comes with everything you need to act on it:

• Room Renders — multiple views of your redesigned space, ready to save or share
• Color Palette — your design's exact colors with hex codes, matched to your chosen style
• Furniture List — every piece named with dimensions, materials, and style tags
• Shop the Look — tap any item to purchase it directly from real online stores
• Download as PDF — your full interior design plan, anywhere you need it

Room Inspiration, Always Saved

Browse interior inspiration and find looks you love. Every project lives in My Designs with its full render collection, color palette, and furniture plan. Your personal style library grows with every design you make.

Private, Secure, and Built for Real Homes
Your room photos and designs stay private and secure. Explore freely.

Download Decory—and see your space differently before changing a thing.

AI Home Design: iHome – Product Description
AI Home Design: iHome is a mobile application that uses artificial intelligence to generate interior and exterior design renderings from user-provided room or building photos. The app covers seven core design functions across indoor and outdoor spaces, allowing users to visualize material, color, layout, and style changes without manual drafting or professional software.\

Core Features
· Interior Design
Redesign any room with premium modern aesthetics. Users can apply curated design styles to living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and home offices. The AI generates photorealistic interior renderings while preserving the original spatial structure.
· Exterior Design
Visualize a modern house facade instantly. Upload a photo of an existing building exterior, and the app produces alternative facade designs with updated cladding, roofing, window treatments, and exterior color schemes.
· Layout Boost
Optimized space arrangements for better flow. The AI analyzes existing floor plans or room layouts and suggests alternative furniture placements, traffic paths, and functional zoning to improve spatial efficiency and movement.
· Garden Design
Create a lush, peaceful outdoor sanctuary. Transform backyards into landscaped gardens with AI-generated planting plans, pathway layouts, water feature placements, and seating area configurations.
· Balcony Design
Cozy balcony setups with breathtaking views. The app generates compact balcony designs featuring space-saving furniture, vertical greenery, lighting arrangements, and decorative elements that complement the surrounding view.
· Clean Up
Magically remove clutter and unwanted objects. Users can select and erase distracting items — cables, furniture, laundry, or other visual noise — from any interior or exterior photo with a single tap.
· Paint Wall / Floor
Instant color and material swaps for surfaces. Experiment with wall paints, wallpapers, floor tiles, wood finishes, and area rugs. The AI applies selected materials to walls, floors, and other flat surfaces in the uploaded image.

Target Users
Homeowners planning renovation or decoration projects
Real estate agents preparing property listings with improved visual presentations
Interior designers seeking rapid visualization tools for client communication
Design enthusiasts exploring stylistic possibilities for personal spaces
No prior design or drafting experience is required. All generations are produced from a single uploaded photo and a few selection inputs.

Subscription:
- We offer both weekly and annual subscription plans to cater to your different needs.
- The subscription fee will be charged to your iTunes Account upon your confirmation of purchase.
- Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period.
- You can manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal at any time through your iTunes Account Settings.
